checks.evidence: “may, but is not required to, request supporting evidence” preserves discretion.
“If requested, the applicant must provide it within 8 business days of the request.”
“is not required to” preserves the absence of a requirement to request evidence in every case.

ratings.reason: Preserves all material source meaning; the deadline anchor clarifies the conditional requirement.

checks.evidence: “A reviewer may request supporting evidence” preserves permission.
“If requested, the applicant must provide it within 8 business days.”
“is not required to do so in every case.”

ratings.reason: Clearly preserves discretion, the conditional obligation, and the business-day deadline. No additional material meaning is omitted.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the full policy without material additions or omissions.

checks.evidence: “Release the shipment only after both the quality manager and the warehouse lead approve it” preserves the prerequisite and both roles.
“both the quality manager and the warehouse lead approve it in writing.”
“Verbal approvals do not count.”

ratings.reason: Preserves both written approvals as prerequisites and excludes verbal approval. No additional material meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: “Release the shipment only after both the quality manager and the warehouse lead have approved it” preserves the prerequisite and both roles.
“both the quality manager and the warehouse lead have approved it in writing.”
“Verbal approval from either person is not enough.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the complete release condition, including prior written approval by both roles and the insufficiency of verbal approval.

cases.preference_reason: Both provide clear, faithful simplifications; their wording differences are not material.

checks.evidence: “Reimbursement covers actual, documented expenses” retains both expense qualifications.
“up to GBP 175 per trip.”
“within 21 calendar days after the trip” followed by “Late claims are ineligible unless” preserves the default deadline and its exception.
“unless Finance grants a written exception.”

ratings.reason: Preserves all reimbursement and eligibility conditions. The initially categorical “must” is qualified by the next sentence, but the split presentation is less direct.

checks.evidence: “Reimbursement covers actual documented expenses” retains both expense qualifications.

“Claims submitted more than 21 calendar days after the trip are ineligible unless” preserves the threshold and default ineligibility.
“unless finance grants a written exception.”
